note: A rule, not a schema. Every entry below is a fact read out of the shipped bundle, with the identifier it was read from, so a reader can re-run the grep in versions.txt and check it.
settings_key_evidence: package.json contributes.configuration; read at activation by the auto-import routine that logs '[AutoImport] Checking for settings file at: ...'

import_document.evidence: z.object({providerProfiles: o, globalSettings: eT.optional()}) parsed from JSON.parse(readFile(path)) -- so the document must be strict JSON, not JSONC

api_provider_evidence: Htr = [...Qtr, ...Btr, ...uNi, ...cNi, ...dNi, 'anthropic', ...]; Mtr is the second half of the union; z.union([z.enum(Htr), z.enum(Mtr)])

openai_compatible_profile.base_url_evidence: createOpenAICompatible builds new URL(baseURL + '/chat/completions'); an unset openAiApiKey is sent as the literal 'not-provided'
openai_compatible_profile.evidence: openAiBaseUrl: z.string().optional(), openAiApiKey: z.string().optional(), openAiModelId: z.string().optional(), openAiCustomModelInfo: AP.nullish(), openAiStreamingEnabled: z.boolean().optional()

openai_custom_model_info.evidence: AP = z.object({maxTokens: z.number().nullish(), maxThinkingTokens: z.number().nullish(), contextWindow: z.number(), supportsImages: z.boolean().optional(), supportsPromptCache: z.boolean(), ...}) -- contextWindow and supportsPromptCache are the only two members with no .optional()/.nullish(), and a profile missing either is dropped silently rather than reported
